key_idea: Handle each side of the origin independently and always serve the farthest remaining location first, letting leftover truck capacity spill onto the next nearer locations.
sketch: Split by sign, sort by distance descending, keep the spare capacity of the last trip. At each location first consume spare capacity, then make ceil(t/K) trips costing 2*distance each and carry the remainder trips*K - t inward. O(N log N). Use 64-bit: the answer can reach about 2.4e9.
